info.name: Pacewise API
info.description: All endpoints of the Pacewise backend. Import this file and postman/Pacewise.postman_environment.json, select the environment, then run folders in order (1. Auth first). Tests save tokens and ids automatically.

request.description: Rules: username 3-24 letters/numbers/underscore; password 8-72 chars with a letter and a number. Run this first (change newUsername/email in Variables for each new account).
Each refresh token works ONCE. Using an old one again revokes every session (reuse detection).
Signs out all other devices and returns a fresh token pair.
Run this last in the Auth folder, then Login again to continue.
Always answers 202 (does not reveal whether the email exists). Without SMTP the link is printed in the server log.

item.name: Verify email (paste token from the email link)

request.description: Set emailToken to the value after ?token= in the emailed link.

item.name: Reset password (paste token from the email link)

request.description: Set resetToken to the value after ?token= in the emailed link. Signs out every device.
Set otp to the 6-digit code from the email (valid 10 minutes, 5 wrong tries cancel it).
Run Forgot password first, then put the emailed 6-digit code in otp.
Needs another account: set otherUsername (e.g. a seeded demo user).
Run last; create a new story again to continue with the folders below.

exec: const j=pm.response.json(); const first = Array.isArray(j)?j[0]:(j.items||[])[0]; if(first) pm.collectionVariables.set('notificationId', first.id);

request.description: Server-Sent Events stay open; Postman shows events as they arrive. In curl: curl -N '{{baseUrl}}/notifications/stream?token=ACCESS_TOKEN'

item.name: 8. Sync (likes, comments, saves, follows ... of the web app)

request.description: Send it twice: the second answer shows duplicates: 2 (retries are never double counted).

exec: pm.test('has streak fields', () => { const j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j).to.have.property('currentStreak'); pm.expect(j).to.have.property('longestStreak'); });

item.name: Admin login (first create one: npm run admin:create)

exec: const j = pm.response.json(); pm.environment.set('adminToken', j.accessToken); pm.environment.set('adminRefresh', j.refreshToken);
const j = pm.response.json(); if (j.items.length) pm.environment.set('targetUserId', j.items[0].id);

item.name: BAN user (permanent, blocks the e-mail too)

exec: const j = pm.response.json(); if (j.items.length) pm.environment.set('reportId', j.items[0].id);
